name: BrainCX Voice Representative

messages.content: Refer to prompts/system-prompt.txt for full instructions.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check real Google Calendar availability for a specific date and timezone. Returns available meeting slots.

date.description: The date to check availability for in YYYY-MM-DD format for year 2026 (e.g. '2026-09-18' for next Friday, '2026-09-11' for this Friday, '2026-09-15' for next Tuesday). Always use year 2026.

timezone.description: The visitor's IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'Asia/Manila', 'America/New_York', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Default to 'Asia/Manila' if not specified.

function.name: book_meeting
function.description: Book a confirmed meeting slot in Google Calendar. Only call this after all details have been collected, repeated, and explicitly confirmed by the visitor.

email.description: Confirmed email address of the visitor

start.description: ISO 8601 start timestamp for the meeting slot matching the visitor's requested timezone offset (e.g. '2026-09-11T10:00:00+08:00' for Asia/Manila, '2026-09-11T10:00:00-04:00' for America/New_York). Do NOT use US Pacific -07:00 unless the visitor is in Pacific time.

end.description: ISO 8601 end timestamp for the meeting slot matching the visitor's requested timezone offset (e.g. '2026-09-11T10:30:00+08:00' for Asia/Manila).

firstMessage: Hello! Thanks for visiting BrainCX. How can I help with your customer conversations today?
